name: multicam-video-preprocessing
description: Multi-camera preprocessing and AI rough-cut suite for 2 to 6 cameras. Supports optional automatically aligned external master audio, camera-audio fallback without OBS, portable FCP7 XML and MP4 delivery, job-isolated GCS uploads, full-length Vertex AI analysis, and deterministic EDL validation. Maintained fork of sylphlin/multicam-video-preprocessing.
